summary: Firefox’s decoder and platform backends now preserve AV1 SVC temporal IDs and decoded color metadata, including HDR and wide-gamut information, across FFmpeg, VideoToolbox, Windows Media Foundation, and remote image transport. Linux Vulkan Video support is more robust when sharing NV12 frames with other GPUs, reuses device information, and avoids NVIDIA decoding configurations known to be unsupported. Hardware codec discovery is also being cached for MediaCapabilities, while encoder and decoder shutdown paths are made safer.
